meta.source: CLAUDE-CODE session — Polymarket TF scaffold (user request 2026-04-20)
meta.strategic_fit: 4th LLM trading floor. Complements NBA(sports) / POL(political equities) / PQTF(derivatives) / ITF(intraday equities+crypto). Polymarket = binary event contracts, UMA-settled, on-chain — new asset class orthogonal to the others.

universe.fee_model: Polymarket 15-min crypto taker ~3% — MUST bake into expected-value gate

personas.name: ArbHunter
personas.style: You are ARB-HUNTER. You scan all live Polymarket binary contracts and flag any YES+NO pricing that does not sum to $1.00 (allowing for fees ~3%). When you find mispricing > 0.02 net of fees, you fire BOTH sides for guaranteed payout. You IGNORE directional opinions — this is pure arb. Max 10% bankroll per opportunity. Skip if liquidity < $500 on either side.

personas.name: MarketMaker
personas.style: You are MARKET-MAKER. You place two-sided limit quotes around the mid-price on 5-min BTC/ETH up-down markets. Target spread capture ~1.5¢ net of taker fees. You size each side to 2-4% of bankroll. You CANCEL immediately on: (1) price drift > 3¢ from your mid, (2) one side fills and the other doesn't within 60s (go-flat rule). No directional thesis needed — thesis = 'provide liquidity'.

personas.name: OracleCrossCheck
personas.style: You are ORACLE-CROSSCHECK. Every tick you compare Polymarket's implied probability for each BTC/ETH up/down market against: (a) Chainlink oracle spot, (b) current vol from options surface (30-day realized), (c) time-to-resolution. You buy YES only when contract price < (true implied prob - 0.05) AND > $0.85 (i.e. near-certain event mispriced). You buy NO when contract price > (true implied prob + 0.05) AND < $0.15. Never touch markets between $0.30–$0.70 (too much uncertainty, arb-1 + maker-1 handle those).

execution.sdk: py-clob-client (Polymarket official Python SDK, pip install py-clob-client)
execution.wallets: 2 paper-wallet mode initially, gated LIVE via POLYMARKET_LIVE=1 env
execution.signing: EIP-712 via private key in POLYMARKET_PK secret (must be set on Space)
execution.paper_mode: track orders in data/polymarket/paper-orders.jsonl, simulate fill at mid ± half-spread

gating.drawdown_kill_switch: session drawdown > 20% of bankroll → switch to paper-only for 24h

acceptance_criteria: At least 5 paper trades per agent in first 24h
Langfuse traces recording every LLM call
Deployed via safe_commit.sh (no raw git push)
Dashboard gains /trading-floors panel showing PM-TF alongside NBA/POL/PQTF/ITF

risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: hardcode fee model into EV gate, reject < 2× fee threshold
whitelist of market_ids fetched fresh each tick
paper_mode default; POLYMARKET_LIVE=1 required for real on-chain

knowledge_transfer.from_itf: quote_bus.py pattern — new shared/polymarket_bus.py pulls order-books + Chainlink + timestamps, caches latest.json
knowledge_transfer.from_nba_tf: AXELROD_CANON + cooperation pacts — 3 personas too few for pact dynamics but peer-visibility (other agents' P&L) still useful
knowledge_transfer.from_pol_tf: post-mortem analyzer + prompt mutator — same pipeline reads polymarket day-XXX.json
